## Overview

This notebook performs functional enrichment analysis on the differential expression results from DESeq2. Because *Artemisia annua* has no functional annotation in public databases like g:Profiler, GO terms and KEGG pathways are assigned to genes through eggNOG-mapper (orthology-based transfer), and over-representation analysis (ORA) is run in R with clusterProfiler. Each test uses a hypergeometric test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Enrichment is run separately for upregulated, downregulated, and all significant DE genes, against GO Biological Process, Molecular Function, and Cellular Component, and against KEGG pathways. Results are visualized as dot plots.

**Method notes:**
- Significant genes: padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 (set in the setup chunk; must match `deseq2.qmd`). The notebook checks its significant-gene count against `deseq2_significant.csv`.
- Transcript-level eggNOG annotations are mapped to genes through `tx2gene.csv`, and GO terms or pathways are unioned per gene.
- Background universe: genes tested by DESeq2 (non-NA padj) that have at least one annotation in the system being tested. GO and KEGG use separate universes.
- Term size limits: 10 to 500 genes for GO, 5 to 500 for KEGG. Giant KEGG overview maps (e.g. "Metabolic pathways") are excluded.
- The terpenoid pathways ko00900 and ko00909 are reported regardless of significance.

Initial workflow adapted from KAUST Academy (lab 7, which used g:Profiler): [https://bioinfo-kaust.github.io/academy-stage3-2026/html/lab7.html](https://bioinfo-kaust.github.io/academy-stage3-2026/html/lab7.html)

**INPUTS:**
- `results/tables/deseq2_all_results.csv`: all DESeq2 results
- `results/tables/deseq2_significant.csv`: significant DESeq2 results (used only as a sanity check)
- `counts/tx2gene.csv`: transcript-to-gene mapping
- `reference/eggnog_annotation/artemisia_annotation.emapper.annotations`: eggNOG-mapper functional annotation

**OUTPUTS** (in `results/enrichment/` unless noted):
- `reference/gene2go.tsv`: gene-to-GO table (written before ontology annotation)
- `gene2go_annotated.tsv`: gene-to-GO table with term names and ontology
- `gene2kegg.tsv`: gene-to-KEGG pathway table
- `universe_go.tsv`, `universe_kegg.tsv`: background gene universes
- `gene_sets.tsv`: genes in each tested set (all_sig, up, down)
- `go_ora_all_terms.tsv`: GO results, all terms tested
- `go_ora_significant.tsv`: GO results, p.adjust < 0.05
- `kegg_ora_all_pathways.tsv`: KEGG results, all pathways tested
- `kegg_ora_significant.tsv`: KEGG results, p.adjust < 0.05
- `enrichment_summary.tsv`: terms tested and significant per gene set and analysis
- `top_hits.tsv`: top 3 significant terms per gene set and analysis
- `dotplot_<set>_<BP|MF|CC>.png`: GO dot plots (set = all_sig, up, or down)
- `dotplot_<set>_KEGG.png`: KEGG dot plots

Dot plots are only produced for gene sets with at least one significant term.


## Setup Conda Environment

```{bash}
#| label: setup-conda-environment

source ~/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics
```


## Load DE Results and Prepare Gene Lists
```{r}
#| label: import-libraries

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(GO.db)
  library(enrichplot)
})

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
rename <- dplyr::rename
slice  <- dplyr::slice
count  <- dplyr::count

# --- EDIT THESE ------------------------------------------
paths <- list(
  tx2gene     = "counts/tx2gene.csv",
  emapper     = "reference/eggnog_annotation/artemisia_annotation.emapper.annotations",
  all_results = "results/tables/deseq2_all_results.csv",
  significant = "results/tables/deseq2_significant.csv",
  out_dir     = "results/enrichment",
  out_dir_fig = "results/figures"
)

# MUST match the thresholds used in deseq2.qmd
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 1
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(paths$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

print("Libraries loaded successfully!")
```

```{r}
#| label: gene-to-go-table

tx2gene <- read_csv(paths$tx2gene, show_col_types = FALSE) # TXNAME, GENEID

emapper <- read_tsv(paths$emapper, comment = "##", na = "-",
                    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

names(emapper)[1] <- "TXNAME"
sum(!is.na(emapper$GOs))    # expect 30426

gene2go <- emapper %>%
  select(TXNAME, GOs) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GOs)) %>%
  inner_join(tx2gene, by = "TXNAME") %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") %>%
  distinct(GENEID, GO = GOs)

write_tsv(gene2go, "reference/gene2go.tsv")

cat("Genes with >=1 GO term:", n_distinct(gene2go$GENEID), "\n")
cat("Unique GO terms:", n_distinct(gene2go$GO), "\n")

```

```{r}
#| label: go-info
go_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db, keys = unique(gene2go$GO),
  columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY"), keytype = "GOID"
) %>% as_tibble() %>% filter(!is.na(ONTOLOGY))

cat("GO IDs not found in GO.db (dropped):",
    n_distinct(gene2go$GO) - nrow(go_info), "\n")

gene2go <- gene2go %>% inner_join(go_info, by = c("GO" = "GOID"))
term2name <- go_info %>% select(GO = GOID, TERM)
```

```{r}
#| label: gene-to-kegg

stopifnot("KEGG_Pathway" %in% names(emapper))

gene2kegg <- emapper %>%
  select(TXNAME, KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_Pathway)) %>%
  inner_join(tx2gene, by = "TXNAME") %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_Pathway, sep = ",") %>%
  filter(str_starts(KEGG_Pathway, "ko")) %>%
  distinct(GENEID, PATHWAY = KEGG_Pathway)

overview_maps <- c("ko01100", "ko01110", "ko01120", "ko01200",
                   "ko01210", "ko01212", "ko01230", "ko01240")
gene2kegg <- gene2kegg %>% filter(!PATHWAY %in% overview_maps)

# Pathway names from the KEGG REST API (needs internet). Falls back to IDs.
term2name_kegg <- tryCatch({
  kp <- KEGGREST::keggList("pathway")
  tibble(PATHWAY = str_replace(names(kp), "^path:map", "ko"), NAME = unname(kp))
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("KEGG REST lookup failed, using IDs as names: ", conditionMessage(e))
  tibble(PATHWAY = unique(gene2kegg$PATHWAY), NAME = unique(gene2kegg$PATHWAY))
})

cat("Genes with >=1 KEGG pathway:", n_distinct(gene2kegg$GENEID), "\n")
cat("Unique pathways:", n_distinct(gene2kegg$PATHWAY), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-deseq2-results

res <- read_csv(paths$all_results, show_col_types = FALSE)

id_col <- intersect(c("GENEID", "gene_id", "gene", "Gene", "...1", "X"),
                    names(res))[1]
stopifnot(!is.na(id_col))
res <- res %>% rename(GENEID = all_of(id_col))

head(res$GENEID, 3)    # expect CTI12_AA...
stopifnot(any(startsWith(res$GENEID, "CTI12_")))
stopifnot(all(c("padj", "log2FoldChange") %in% names(res)))
```

```{r}
#| label: go-universe-gene-sets
universe <- intersect(res$GENEID[!is.na(res$padj)], gene2go$GENEID)

sig <- res %>% filter(!is.na(padj), padj < padj_cut, abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_cut)

# Sanity check: should reproduce deseq2_significant.csv
n_sig_file <- nrow(read_csv(paths$significant, show_col_types = FALSE))
cat("Significant here:", nrow(sig), "| in deseq2_significant.csv:", n_sig_file, "\n")
if (nrow(sig) != n_sig_file)
  warning("Thresholds differ from deseq2.qmd. Adjust padj_cut/lfc_cut above.")

gene_sets <- list(
  all_sig = sig$GENEID,
  up      = sig$GENEID[sig$log2FoldChange > 0],
  down    = sig$GENEID[sig$log2FoldChange < 0]
)

tibble(
  set = names(gene_sets),
  n_genes = lengths(gene_sets),
  n_in_universe = map_int(gene_sets, ~ length(intersect(.x, universe)))
) %>% print()
cat("Universe size:", length(universe), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: kegg-universe
#| 
universe_kegg <- intersect(res$GENEID[!is.na(res$padj)], gene2kegg$GENEID)
cat("KEGG universe size:", length(universe_kegg), "\n")
```

## Run GO Enrichment/Over-Representation Analysis

```{r}
#| label: go-over-representation-analysis

run_ora <- function(genes, ont) {
  t2g <- gene2go %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == ont) %>% select(GO, GENEID)
  enricher(
    gene = intersect(genes, universe), universe = universe,
    TERM2GENE = t2g, TERM2NAME = term2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,     # keep everything; filter below
    minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500, pAdjustMethod = "BH"
  )
}

ontologies <- c(BP = "BP", MF = "MF", CC = "CC")

ora <- expand_grid(set = names(gene_sets), ont = names(ontologies)) %>%
  mutate(result = map2(set, ont, ~ run_ora(gene_sets[[.x]], ontologies[[.y]])))

ora_tbl <- ora %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(result, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(tbl = map(result, ~ as_tibble(.x@result))) %>%
  select(set, ont, tbl) %>%
  unnest(tbl)

ora_sig <- ora_tbl %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

ora_sig %>% count(set, ont, name = "n_sig_terms")
```

## Run KEGG Enrichment/Over-Representation Analysis

```{r}
#| label: kegg-over-expression-analysis

run_ora_kegg <- function(genes) {
  enricher(
    gene = intersect(genes, universe_kegg), universe = universe_kegg,
    TERM2GENE = gene2kegg %>% select(PATHWAY, GENEID),
    TERM2NAME = term2name_kegg,
    pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 5, maxGSSize = 500, pAdjustMethod = "BH"
  )
}

kegg_ora <- map(gene_sets, run_ora_kegg)

kegg_tbl <- kegg_ora %>%
  discard(is.null) %>%
  map(~ as_tibble(.x@result)) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "set")

if (nrow(kegg_tbl) == 0)
  kegg_tbl <- tibble(set = character(), ID = character(),
                     Description = character(), p.adjust = numeric())

kegg_sig <- kegg_tbl %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

kegg_sig %>% count(set, name = "n_sig_pathways")
```

```{r}
#| label: terpenoid-pathway-check

kegg_tbl %>%
  filter(ID %in% c("ko00900", "ko00909")) %>%
  select(set, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, Count)
```

```{r}
#| label: top-go-and-kegg-terms

ora_sig %>%
  group_by(set, ont) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 5) %>%
  select(set, ont, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, p.adjust, Count) %>%
  arrange(set, ont, p.adjust) %>%
  print(n = 60)

# KEGG
kegg_sig %>%
  group_by(set) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 5) %>%
  select(set, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, p.adjust, Count) %>%
  arrange(set, p.adjust) %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

```{r}
#| label: dotplots

plot_dot <- function(r, title, file, n = 15) {
  r@pvalueCutoff <- 0.05; r@qvalueCutoff <- 1   # plot only significant terms
  n_show <- min(n, sum(r@result$p.adjust < 0.05))

  p <- dotplot(r, showCategory = n_show,
               label_format = 45,   # wrap at 45 chars instead of 30
               font.size = 11) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.85))  # tighter wrapped lines

  # scale height with the number of terms (~0.55 in per term + room for axis/title)
  h <- max(5, 0.55 * n_show + 1.5)
  ggsave(file, p, width = 10, height = h, dpi = 200)
  p
}

# GO
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ora))) {
  r <- ora$result[[i]]
  if (is.null(r) || !any(r@result$p.adjust < 0.05)) next
  p <- plot_dot(r, paste(ora$set[i], ora$ont[i]),
                file.path(paths$out_dir_fig,
                          sprintf("dotplot_%s_%s.png", ora$set[i], ora$ont[i])))
  print(p)
}

# KEGG
for (s in names(kegg_ora)) {
  r <- kegg_ora[[s]]
  if (is.null(r) || !any(r@result$p.adjust < 0.05)) next
  p <- plot_dot(r, paste(s, "KEGG"),
                file.path(paths$out_dir_fig, sprintf("dotplot_%s_KEGG.png", s)))
  print(p)
}
```

## Save Results to TSV Files
```{r}
#| label: save-all-enrichment-results

save_tsv <- function(x, f) write_tsv(x, file.path(paths$out_dir, f))

# Annotation tables and inputs (for reproducibility)
save_tsv(gene2go %>% select(GENEID, GO, ONTOLOGY, TERM), "gene2go_annotated.tsv")
save_tsv(gene2kegg, "gene2kegg.tsv")
save_tsv(tibble(GENEID = universe), "universe_go.tsv")
save_tsv(tibble(GENEID = universe_kegg), "universe_kegg.tsv")
save_tsv(enframe(gene_sets, name = "set", value = "GENEID") %>% unnest(GENEID),
         "gene_sets.tsv")

# Enrichment results (the geneID column lists member genes, "/"-separated)
save_tsv(ora_tbl,  "go_ora_all_terms.tsv")
save_tsv(ora_sig,  "go_ora_significant.tsv")
save_tsv(kegg_tbl, "kegg_ora_all_pathways.tsv")
save_tsv(kegg_sig, "kegg_ora_significant.tsv")

list.files(paths$out_dir)
```

## Create summary reports
```{r}
#| label: summary-params

params <- tibble(
  parameter = c("DE cutoff: padj <", "DE cutoff: |log2FC| >",
                "ORA significance: p.adjust <", "GO term size (genes)",
                "KEGG pathway size (genes)", "Genes tested (non-NA padj)",
                "GO universe", "KEGG universe"),
  value = c(padj_cut, lfc_cut, 0.05, "10-500", "5-500",
            sum(!is.na(res$padj)), length(universe), length(universe_kegg))
) %>% mutate(value = as.character(value))
knitr::kable(params)

set_sizes <- tibble(
  set = names(gene_sets),
  n_genes = lengths(gene_sets),
  n_in_go_universe = map_int(gene_sets, ~ length(intersect(.x, universe))),
  n_in_kegg_universe = map_int(gene_sets, ~ length(intersect(.x, universe_kegg)))
)
knitr::kable(set_sizes)
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-counts

enrich_summary <- bind_rows(
  ora_tbl %>% mutate(analysis = ont),
  kegg_tbl %>% mutate(analysis = "KEGG")
) %>%
  group_by(set, analysis) %>%
  summarise(terms_tested = n(),
            terms_significant = sum(p.adjust < 0.05),
            .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(enrich_summary)
save_tsv(enrich_summary, "enrichment_summary.tsv")
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-top-hits

top_hits <- bind_rows(
  ora_sig  %>% mutate(analysis = ont),
  kegg_sig %>% mutate(analysis = "KEGG")
) %>%
  group_by(set, analysis) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(set, analysis, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, p.adjust, Count)

knitr::kable(top_hits, digits = 4)
save_tsv(top_hits, "top_hits.tsv")
```
